checklist.note: Embedded OTDR shows reflective event at ~23.15 km from A with 2.95 dB loss and reflectance -37.8 dB; B sees 2.93 dB loss at 0.001 km. Suggests high loss at B-ODF side

checklist.item: Run OTDR event table at 1550 nm from A and B
checklist.note: OTDR at 1550 nm from A shows 2.92 dB loss at 23.15 km reflective event; from B shows 2.9 dB loss at -0.003 km

checklist.item: Inspect connectors A-ODF, MID-PP if present, B-ODF
checklist.note: B-ODF inspection shows dirty/damaged end face with multiple particles and smudge; A-ODF and MID-PP clean

checklist.item: Review site notes for recent work
checklist.note: Site notes show patching work at site B ODF on 2026-10-23 11:43 UTC, shortly before alarm raise at 13:00

checklist.item: Correlate findings to identify single root cause
checklist.note: Root cause identified: dirty B-ODF connector after patching on 23 Oct, causing ~2.9 dB extra loss and RX low warning

args.evidence: RX power dropped ~2.8 dB after 23 Oct patching at site B ODF; power measurement shows A-TX 0.75 dBm to B-ODF -7.44 dBm = 8.19 dB loss vs commissioning 5.41 dB. OTDR from A at 1550 nm shows 2.92 dB loss at 23.15 km reflective event at B-ODF, and from B shows 2.9 dB loss at -0.003 km. Inspection of B-ODF shows dirty/damaged end face with particles and smudge, consistent with post-patching contamination.

evidence_refs.quote: Patching work at site B ODF: jumpers moved to free a port for a new service.
